title: People Before Ashes
description: Rescue Mira and the survivors in Burned Village.

title: The Northern Road
description: Defeat the Ash Wolf at Northern Gate.

title: The Hollow Protector
description: Defeat the guardian at Emberwood Shrine.

title: A Fragment of Dawn
description: Read the runes and restore the Sun Sigil.

title: The Keeper's Oath
description: Read the archive in Sunken Ruins.

title: A Brother Remembered
description: Find the locket in Sunken Ruins and return it to Mira.

title: The Cinder Crown
description: Defeat the Warden and choose an ending.

title: A Light Through Snow
description: Recover a signal lens in Glacier Sanctum and restore Sera's beacon.

title: What the Mountain Kept
description: Find the caravan crate. Decide whether its supplies belong to the camp or to you.

title: The Sentinel's Promise
description: Read the glacier oath and settle the sentinel's vigil through combat or keeper diplomacy.

title: Salt and Mercy
description: Recover Marin's medicine on the coast and deliver it to Mira at camp.

title: Stars Above the Tide
description: Find the star chart and choose whose ships the repaired beacon will guide.

title: The Last Harbor Bell
description: Resolve the drowned captain's watch. Camp reputation and his old bell open a peaceful path.
